Is this good news for free will? Yes and No. Yes, because it appears to make room for conscious free will. No, because it gives conscious free will a disappointingly limited role to play.

is free will an important good?

“Assuming that one can extrapolate these results to volitional acts generally, they do not exclude a possible role for free will ... However, the potential role for free will would be constrained; it would be changed from being an initiator of the voluntary act to one only of controlling the outcome of the volitional process, after the individual becomes aware of an intention ... to act now.”
